doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Burns session opens: a barrelhouse piano man
summary: Buddy Burns, in a separate session, tries to recall a barrelhouse pianist and prepares to play.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: Oh, what's he called him? What do you name him? It was a bell house piano man. No, Eddie Johnson is a sax man. Talking about, you can't call his name either? He's raised up under him, he's older too. Pretty old man, if he was living, he's dead now. Yeah, he's a good feeling. Played all that.
I'll play y'all. I'll play the salted dog first. That dog, I almost forgot how to play. I'll play y'all.
